inputs.text: A baby stopped breathing in a crowded TSA line at JFK on Thursday, and an ICE agent stepped in as the family faced a crisis. DHS released footage of the response. Whatever people think about immigration policy, a uniformed officer taking responsibility and helping a family in a frightening moment deserves respect. We should value service and courage—not reduce every law-enforcement officer to a political symbol. A society that honors responsibility and protects families should recognize acts like this.
